references.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! We bless you from the house of the Lord.

Go through, go through the gates! Clear the way for the people! Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones! Raise a banner for the peoples! Behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth: Say to the daughter of Zion, 'Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.'

Shout aloud and sing for joy, O daughter of Zion! Cry out, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king comes to you. He is righteous and having salvation, humble and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
